title: Every `make build` of cs-campaign reports +dirty, even from a clean commit
foundBy: user report (host): "Why does cs-campaign version show -dirty as it's from a clean commit?"

evidence.verified: `make build install` on 339b992 installed binaries that report `v0.0.0-20260927052229-339b992fdbe4` with `vcs.modified=false`, and `git status` stayed empty. The same build of e4629b9 reported `+dirty`. The installed cs-campaign contains the 3,408,032 bytes of `bin/guest/cs-campaign-member-amd64`, and so does a `make build-go-embedded` build. `make snapshot` without `--parallelism 1` built all four targets: each embeds its own arch's guest and not the other, and none is dirty. `make ci` passed on the tree committed as 339b992, with 10 of 10 smoke scenarios run.

resolution: `make guestbin` writes the guest and an overlay file under `bin/guest/`, one pair per arch. `make build`, `build-go-embedded` and goreleaser pass `go build -overlay`, which has the compiler read the guest in place of the placeholder. The placeholder is never written, so Go stamps a clean version. Each arch reads its own guest, so release targets no longer need `--parallelism 1`.
details:
`cs-campaign version` printed `v0.0.0-20260927022458-e4629b91e506+dirty` for a binary `make install` built from e4629b9 on a clean tree. `go version -m` on it shows `vcs.modified=true`, and `cs-dispatch-viewer` from the same build carries the same stamp.

The build writes the real guest binary over the committed placeholder `internal/cli/assets/cs-campaign-member.bin`, compiles, and then restores the placeholder with `git checkout`. Go stamps the version while that tracked file is modified, so the stamp says `+dirty` whatever the commit. The tree is clean again afterwards, which is why `git status` shows nothing.

The binary is the one the build means to make, but its version no longer names a commit. A release built by goreleaser gets the same stamp, since its pre hook overwrites the same file. An interrupted build also leaves the 3.4 MB guest binary in a tracked file.
